description: Search Contracts Finder, the UK government's list of public sector contract opportunities and awards, usually those over £12,000, by keywords, stage, status, region, postcode, dates, value and CPV code. Read a notice in full with its contact, documents and awarded suppliers, get it as open contracting data (OCDS), and look up CPV codes. No account or API key required.
